athletics = track and field sports such as running, jumping and throwing
gymnastics = a sport of exercises on the floor and apparatus that need strength, balance and control
martial arts = combat sports such as judo, karate or taekwondo
extreme sports = sports with a high level of danger or adrenaline, such as climbing or rafting
motorsport = competitive racing in cars, motorbikes or similar vehicles
triathlon = a race combining swimming, cycling and running
pentathlon = a contest of five events, in the modern form including fencing and riding
weightlifting = a sport of lifting a loaded bar from the ground to above the head
archery = the sport of shooting arrows at a target with a bow
fencing = a combat sport using a foil, épée or sabre
rowing = the sport of racing boats that are moved with oars
canoeing = paddling a canoe, often as a race or on fast water
windsurfing = riding a board with a sail, using the wind on water
scuba diving = swimming underwater with a tank of compressed air
rock climbing = climbing natural rock faces using hands, feet and safety gear
mountaineering = climbing high mountains, often with ice, snow and altitude
bouldering = climbing short, difficult routes without a rope, using crash mats
parkour = moving through a city or course by jumping, climbing and vaulting
figure skating = ice skating that combines jumps, spins and dance steps
biathlon = a winter sport combining cross-country skiing and rifle shooting
